title: The Holy River from the Temple
description: A man led Ezekiel out from the temple threshold and measured along a river flowing eastward, which grew deeper at each step—from ankles to knees to hips until it became a river too deep to cross except by swimming. The river flowed down into the Arabah valley and healed the sea, so that it teemed with fish from En-Gedi to En-Eglaim. On both banks grew fruit trees that bore fresh fruit every month for food, while their leaves were for healing [ref:Ezekiel 47:1-12|Ezekiel 47:1-12].
